title: 헌법재판소 심판정 설치에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Seating Positions, etc.)
(1) The Justices shall sit facing forward on the bench, and participating officials, etc. shall sit at the center below the bench. <Amended on June 1, 1995>
(2) Facing the Justices, the petitioners shall sit on the left and the respondents on the right. <Amended on July 19, 2019>
(3) A lectern shall be placed to the right of the petitioners' seats and to the left of the respondents' seats, respectively, facing the Justices. <Amended on July 19, 2019>
(4) The witness stand shall be placed at the center of the reserved seats for representatives, etc., facing the Justices. <Amended on June 1, 1995; July 31, 2008; July 19, 2019>
